# /crav1-fix-bug

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a bug that already exists](../../from-fix-bug.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-fix-bug/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Name one real bug the user already named.

## Runs when

The user names a real bug. Called by the user.

This is one of the seven starter options. Asking for startup options names it and does not run it.

## Reads

In short: That bug and a spec already in front.

Reads only the bug the user named and a spec already in front of them.

## Writes

In short: Nothing.

Writes nothing.

## Does not

Leaves code, specs, plans, `verify.md`, and `work-item.md` alone.

Limits and exceptions: no bug named, or not a real bug, stops with no lane. Spark, specify, plan, and verify do not run it. When the bug changes how the parts connect, it asks once whether to run [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md) and does not run it.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: The lane it names (Specify, Plan, or Build)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Start. Starter option: yes. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.7.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-fix-bug

Bug: <what is wrong>
Seen: <verify | a report | production>

Name the lane. Do not edit code. Do not open a pull request.
```
